column2: [intro]
I was late for the dentist appointment
I ran so fast, but I slipped and did a pirouette
My teeth hit the sidewalk
But it doesn't matter, it makes people laugh in the evening
It's a shame, but it's not a big deal
Don't worry, it can happen
We laugh, we have fun, it's life that derails
It's a shame, but it's not a big deal
I went to the beach to tan
But I forgot to put on sunscreen, what an idea
I turned red like a tomato
But never mind, I'll have a different color
It's a shame, but it's not a big deal
Don't worry, it can happen
We laugh, we have fun, it's life that derails
It's a shame, but it's not a big deal
[ solo ]
So no matter the little troubles
Let's laugh at everything and enjoy life
Because it's a shame, but it's not a big deal
We dance, we sing, we're happy together at any time
[outro]
